name: Wessex Building Society

ring.prompt: Welcome to Wessex Building Society. Calls are recorded for training and quality. You are number four in the queue.

menu.prompt: For balances and payments, press one. To report a lost card, press two. For bereavement services, press three. For anything else, press four.
menu.wrongKeyPrompt: Sorry, that isn't a valid option. Please try again.

holdAnnouncement: Thank you for holding. Your call is important to us. An adviser will be with you shortly.

clerk.greeting: Bereavement team, Susan speaking. I'm sorry for your loss. Can I take the full name of the account holder who has passed away?

turns.reprompt: Sorry, could you spell the surname for me?

turns.say: Thank you. And the date they passed away?
turns.reprompt: Sorry, could you give me that date again?

turns.say: And do you have the account number or the sort code to hand?
turns.reprompt: No trouble at all — we can trace it another way.

documents: grant of probate or the will
outcome.closing: I've opened a bereavement case, your reference is {REF}. We will need the account number, or the branch can trace it with the death certificate. Is there anything else?

quirk: Asks for an account number most families do not have — Afterward refuses to guess and flips amber.
